dialogues.speaker: Qiming
dialogues.text: Hello there. Are you here to have your fortune told, by any chance?

dialogues.speaker: Qiming
dialogues.text: Every Lantern Rite, many people come to me to have their fortunes read, whether it be for their careers, their health, their literal fortunes... The works.

dialogues.speaker: Qiming
dialogues.text: It's actually a little bothersome, but more income is more income. I can't complain.

dialogues.speaker: Qiming
dialogues.text: And now that that fellow who keeps bugging me about his romantic prospects is gone, I can finally have some peace of mind...

dialogues.speaker: Zhihua
dialogues.text: Madam Qiming, this time I should like for you to read my fortune on the matter of... my love life.

dialogues.speaker: Qiming
dialogues.text: Love life... again? This must be the tenth time this month...

dialogues.speaker: Zhihua
dialogues.text: I only keep coming because your predictions are so accurate! Especially that one thing that you keep telling me, "Being preoccupied with the outcome of a divination is not conducive to finding true love."

dialogues.speaker: Zhihua
dialogues.text: That's why from now on, my focus will be solely on the divination itself, not the outcome.

dialogues.speaker: Qiming
dialogues.text: I see. Well, let me try to explain this differently...

dialogues.speaker: Qiming
dialogues.text: True love may be impossibly far away, or it may be right under your nose. You cannot force it. But when its day comes, it will reveal itself to you right before your very eyes... and who knows, maybe today will be that day.

dialogues.speaker: Zhihua
dialogues.text: Aha! I understand. I understand it now!

dialogues.speaker: Qiming
dialogues.text: Pray tell what you presume to have understood...

dialogues.speaker: Zhihua
dialogues.text: You DO feel the same way! From this day forth I will live solely to bring you happiness. Will you marry me!?

dialogues.speaker: Qiming
dialogues.text: ...No thank you.

dialogues.speaker: Zhihua
dialogues.text: Well, are you free tonight?

dialogues.speaker: Qiming
dialogues.text: No. And now I'm calling the guards.

dialogues.speaker: Qiming
dialogues.text: Hello traveler. Do you share my passion for antiques?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Antiques?

dialogues.speaker: Qiming
dialogues.text: That's right! I might make a meager living doing fortune-telling down at the docks, but I still love collecting antique items.

dialogues.speaker: Qiming
dialogues.text: Linlang is infamously shrewd when it comes to money, we've been acquainted for years and she never budges a Mora on the price... Maybe I don't have enough charm?

dialogues.speaker: Qiming
dialogues.text: It's strange though, because my divination clearly said my chances of finding true love today are optimal...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Qiming
dialogues.text: Bye.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Could you please tell me my fortune?

dialogues.speaker: Qiming
dialogues.text: So you want to know your horoscope for the day? Well then, go ahead, take a fortune. But no returns, mind you, even if you pull an unlucky one!

dialogues.speaker: Qiming
dialogues.text: You again... Here to have your fortune told?

dialogues.speaker: Zhihua
dialogues.text: Madam Qiming, is it not a fine day today? I propose that we—

dialogues.speaker: Qiming
dialogues.text: This day is indeed an auspicious one. All is in order in Heaven and Earth, and destiny is smiling down.

dialogues.speaker: Zhihua
dialogues.text: I'm glad you agree! In which case, Qiming, what say you we—

dialogues.speaker: Qiming
dialogues.text: Do you want your fortune told, or not? Let me guess — love life again this time?

dialogues.speaker: Zhihua
dialogues.text: O—Okay, erm, yes; let's get the latest on my love life. And then, I should like for you to go with me to the Mingxiao Lantern site—

dialogues.speaker: Qiming
dialogues.text: I'm afraid your fortunes are looking dire today in matters of love. To be clear, even if you waited till the sea ran dry, or ventured to the ends of the earth... all your efforts would ultimately prove futile.

dialogues.speaker: Zhihua
dialogues.text: Ugh... You could have phrased it more gently, perhaps...

dialogues.speaker: Qiming
dialogues.text: Okay, time's up. Please pay and move out of the way for the next customer. Thank you!
